Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Dental College Kalaburagi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Dental College Kalaburagi?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Professor and Assistant Professor posts at ESIC Dental College Kalaburagi is scheduled for 25 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time for registration.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: For Professor (Orthodontics), a BDS degree with a Post Graduate qualification and 5 years of teaching experience as an Associate Professor is required. For Assistant Professor posts, a BDS degree with a Masters in Dental Surgery is the minimum qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is not exceeding 65 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved category candidates as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for ESIC Dental College Kalaburagi recruitment?
faq.answer: SC/ST/Female candidates are exempted from paying any application fee. All other categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 300/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Professor and Assistant Professor positions at ESIC Dental College Kalaburagi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Professor and Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Professor position is Rs. 2,34,630/- per month, and for the Assistant Professor position, it is Rs. 1,34,046/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ESIC Dental College & Hospital located?
faq.answer: The ESIC Dental College & Hospital is located in Kalaburagi, Karnataka.
